notes: Draft evidence contract only. A phase string cannot satisfy a transition gate. Operative F1 requires one content-addressed F0→F1 transition. Operative F2 requires both that validated prior F0→F1 record and a current F1→F2 record whose approved payload binds the prior transition digest, so F2 cannot be entered directly from F0. The prior F1 transition must itself have satisfied the F1 Active-Member, independent-role and effective treasury/domain/repository delegation criteria on its own effective date; later F2 maturity cannot retroactively cure an invalid F1 transition. Historical institutional authority for admissions and lifecycle actions is derived from these validated transition dates rather than trusted from a self-declared phase label.
